projects.name: Project
details: Nintex to NAC Workflow Modernization — Nintex Automation Cloud Dec 2025 - Present
• Rebuilt SharePoint 2016 Nintex forms and workflows in NAC by recreating approval logic, form rules, email alerts, reminders, and
document update actions.
• Conducted testing, debugging, user validation, and deployment checks to reduce workflow failures during migration from on-premises to cloud.

projects.name: Project
details: SP2016 to SharePoint Online Migration — ShareGate and Microsoft 365 Jul 2024 - Aug 2025
• Participated in migration planning, pre-checks, site mapping, permission validation, metadata review, and ShareGate migration from
SP2016 to SPO.
• Verified migrated content by checking item counts, document versions, broken permissions, navigation, list structure, and business user
access.

projects.name: Project
details: Communication Flow Automation — Power Automate Jan 2025 - Nov 2025
• Engineered communication flows with branded HTML and CSS templates, wave-based scheduling, and OOO detection for large enterprise
campaigns.
• Enabled delivery reporting and Elevated campaign reliability by reducing missed communications and controlling mail delivery load.

projects.name: Project
details: SPO and Exchange Governance Dashboard — Power BI and PowerShell Jan 2025 - Nov 2025
• Prepared PowerShell scripts to collect tenant-level data for 20,000+ SharePoint Online sites, including storage usage, site types, creation
dates, ownership, and governance indicators.
• Configured Power BI dashboards to show tenant insights, top storage-consuming sites, permission trends, governance gaps, and reporting
summaries for administrators.

projects.name: Project
details: Leave Management System — Power Apps and Power Automate Sep 2025 - Dec 2025
• Enhanced a medium-complexity leave management application using Power Apps with SharePoint Online as the backend data source.
• Configured manager and HR approval flows, Systematized notifications, status tracking, and dashboards for leave monitoring.

projects.name: Project
details: SPFx SharePoint Enhancements — SharePoint Framework Nov 2024 - Dec 2025
• Assembled SPFx web parts and custom UI enhancements using React, TypeScript, REST APIs, and PNP JS for modern SharePoint pages.
• Boosted user interaction through responsive layouts, reusable components, role-based visibility , and structured integration with
SharePoint data.
